title: Colours for the Boat
offer: A great boat needs colours! Bring me three pots of paint from Dagny, and I paint your boat red and blue, with a dragon head on the prow.

steps.load_say: Red ochre, blue woad and white chalk, ground fine in linseed oil.

steps.say: One night of painting. Look: red and blue stripes, and a dragon head with golden eyes. Everybody will know your boat!

reward.gift: a painted boat with a dragon head

fact: Viking ships were painted in bright colours, and their prows carved as dragons and snakes.
